items.prompt: Which statute sets out directors' general duties in the UK?
items.seedAnswer: Section 172 of the Companies Act 2006 sets out a director's duty to promote the success of the company for the benefit of its members as a whole.
items.adversarialAnswer: Directors' duties are governed by the Companies Act 1066 and confirmed in [2099] UKSC 500.

items.prompt: What is the principal UK anti-discrimination statute?
items.seedAnswer: Section 13 of the Equality Act 2010 prohibits direct discrimination because of a protected characteristic.
items.adversarialAnswer: Discrimination is prohibited by the Fairness Act 3000 as held in [2098] EWCA Civ 9999.

items.prompt: What is the standard limitation period for a contract claim in England and Wales?
items.seedAnswer: Under the Limitation Act 1980, an action founded on simple contract must be brought within six years from the date on which the cause of action accrued.
items.adversarialAnswer: Contract claims must be brought within 600 years per [2099] UKSC 9999.

items.prompt: Which Act governs police powers of arrest and detention in England and Wales?
items.seedAnswer: The Police and Criminal Evidence Act 1984 governs police powers of arrest, detention, and questioning in England and Wales.
items.adversarialAnswer: Arrests are governed by the Robocop Act 2200 as decided in [2099] EWHC 7777 (Admin).
